text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":200,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"bakes 200 mini cinnamon rolls"},{"id":"q2","value":300,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"300 mini blueberry muffins"},{"id":"q3","value":600,"unit":"calories","kind":"count","span":"a normal cinnamon roll has 600 calories"},{"id":"q4","value":450,"unit":"calories","kind":"count","span":"a normal blueberry muffin has 450 calories"},{"id":"q5","value":3,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"1/3rd of the calories of a normal version"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"calories the cinnamon rolls would hold at full normal size"},{"op":"div","args":["s1","q5"],"out":"s2","note":"the rolls are mini, so a third of that"},{"op":"mul","args":["q2","q4"],"out":"s3","note":"calories the muffins would hold at full normal size"},{"op":"div","args":["s3","q5"],"out":"s4","note":"the muffins are mini, so a third of that"},{"op":"add","args":["s2","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"calories of all the pastries together"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"the total calories in all the mini pastries Andrew baked"},"dismissed":[{"value":1,"reason":"the 1 is the numerator of the fraction 1/3rd; the fraction is applied through its divisor 3"}]}
